_status: draft for expert review; fields containing "verify" are unconfirmed

legal_basis.legacy_note: reports dated before 2026-02-15 follow TT 76/2017; plugin flags which regime a project falls under

scope.authority: publish load capacity: Bộ NN&MT (inter-provincial), UBND tỉnh (intra-provincial)

rules: boundary between two adjacent cross-sections, by flow change, water use, protection needs
tidal reach where salinity >= 4.0 permille intrusion length: one segment
segments crossing urban, dense residential, industrial parks/clusters, craft villages, heavily loaded or polluted waters, conservation areas: may be one segment
reach < 10 km and none of the above: merge with adjacent reach or treat as one segment

parameters.additional: set by the competent authority (water-use purpose, QCVN, discharge nature)

direct.use_when: no wastewater source discharges directly into the segment

indirect.use_when: wastewater sources discharge into the segment

use_when: tidal reach (salinity >= 4.0 permille): model is the ONLY method

methods.NPtd: max load lost to in-river transformation; may be omitted if reliable data is missing (Art. 9.4)

scenarios.base: mean dry-season flow + max load per QCVN surface-water limit matching current quality class
scenarios.by_use: mean dry-season flow + max load per limit matching planned water-use purpose

formulas.Ltd: Cqc * Qs * 86.4      # Cqc mg/L, Qs m3/s
formulas.Lt: Ct * Qt * 86.4      # point source; Qt = max discharge from monitoring or permit
formulas.lake_non_daily_operation: Mtn = (Cqc - Cnn) * Vh * 1e-3   # kg; Vh = mean dry-season volume m3

base_scenario.exception: with treatment ensuring target quality, may use a lower class than current but never lower than C

cqc_selection.by_use_scenario: class per planned water use (A, B or C); same exception, never lower than C

data_requirements.Qs: mean dry-season flow from hydro-meteorological observations (Art. 10.2)

river_water_quality.Cnn: mean of >= 10 samples in dry season, frequency fitting flow variation; use agency monitoring data if available

wastewater.Ct: mean of >= 4 samples, >= 1 day per sample (no wet/dry distinction); use legal monitoring data if available
wastewater.Qt: max discharge from monitoring or from environmental permit/registration

data_requirements.planned_sources: if planning already identifies future sources, add their loads using QCVN wastewater limits (Art. 12.6)

model_requirements.text: simulate hydraulic regime and water quality incl. self-purification where biochemical reactions matter
model calibrated and validated before use
computation grid, cross-sections, boundary conditions defined
river network, boundary conditions, point and diffuse source data
simulates diffusion and transformation of pollutants
model result used in Ltn = Ltd - Lnn (direct form, Art. 9.3)

result_format.per_parameter: Ltn in kg/day, shown on map per parameter and per scenario
result_format.interpretation: Ltn > 0 still has capacity; Ltn <= 0 no capacity
result_format.lake: justify purpose, volume, parameters, method; state capacity per parameter
